scope: Current repository-declared appliance plus explicitly labeled development/build alternatives; registry snapshot is supplemental, not deployment attestation.
excluded: Ironlog deployment/configuration bundle itself; not a separate software product in this BOM
HyperDX and its MongoDB app-state store (removed 2026-11-03; existing installs clean up per docs/local-auth.md)
Historical on-box Keycloak, PostgreSQL and oauth2-proxy (not deployed by current stack)
Deferred AI/MCP and cancelled ECS work
FerretDB and other proposed replacements (not implemented)
Customer log-producing operating systems and external browsers
Cloud-provider hardware, firmware, hypervisor, managed-service internals and organization-specific TLS terminator
known_gaps: Grafana plugin version pinned (4.23.4) but plugin artifact not scanned.
Transitive license coverage incomplete; image scanners do not establish total FOSS compliance.
No supplier SF-328, ownership/control disclosures or agency FOCI determination.
No vulnerability, malware, reproducible-build or runtime-egress attestation.

components.name: ClickHouse Server
components.notes: Exact 26.8 LTS build tag. Upstream Apache license does not license every bundled library. Foreign investment disclosed; no current cap table/control rights supplied. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-clickhouse (images/clickhouse/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-clickhouse:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.

components.name: Grafana OSS
components.notes: Image is grafana/grafana (grafana-oss stopped publishing at 13.0.2); default license AGPL-3.0-only per LICENSING.md, with Apache-2.0 directories and third-party licenses. Disclosed GIC investment is historical evidence requiring current ownership review. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-grafana (images/grafana/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-grafana:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.

components.name: Vector
components.notes: One unique appliance image; host collector always present, AWS collector enabled when configured. Agent binaries and the k8s shipper (0.61.0-distroless-libc, not scanned) use 0.61.0. Supplier clearance and bundled/static libraries remain unreviewed. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-vector (images/vector/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-vector:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.
